title: Profitable traders: do ya’ll have multiple set ups that you’ll trade, or only 1 set up?
summary: Based off my very limited knowledge, I’m under the impression that set ups work better for mean reversion settings, some work better for trending settings, etc. Of course, the price of any given pair is never always in one given setting and thus you can’t always apply the same set up and have it work every time. Do you have different set ups for different settings, or do you hold until you know you’re in your favourable setting?submitted by/u/Dragosfgv[link][comments]
